title: Vector and Archive
author: Xanthe Iversen
blurb: Sable Oyelaran, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
